notes: Official KCE 2026 candidate filing list (all 2026 races, filing week, campaign website/email). Re-fetched for the general; byte-identical to the primary package's copy (same sha256). KCE publishes no general-specific CSV: 2026-general-candidates.csv, 2026-general-election-candidates.csv and 2026-november-candidates.csv all 404, and neither candidates.aspx?eid=55 nor the November 2026 page links a CSV. Its Ballot Order column is the filing-week primary order, so parse_candidates.py takes general ballot order from the eid=55 list instead.
